name: Syed Nafiz Reja Hasib
identity: Two years of cyclic-durability testing and failure analysis on superelastic NiTi components at Denco Manufacturing (2024-2026), together with a BEng in Civil Engineering at Southwest Petroleum University, led to independent computational mechanics on constitutive modelling, thin-shell stability, seismic systems and embodied carbon.
bio: From 2024 to 2026 I tested superelastic NiTi components for cyclic durability and failure at Denco Manufacturing. That work, and a BEng in Civil Engineering from Southwest Petroleum University, is the start of the computational mechanics on this site: constitutive models, thin-shell stability, seismic systems and embodied carbon.
currently: Applying for Erasmus Mundus STRAINS, MS2 and FRP++, and related MSc and PhD places, for September 2027.
